asked.item: Reconnect shows the 20-account limit error for the same account
How to get past the limit so Reconnect works

verdict.reason: The help pages state that reconnecting counts against the connected-account limit, which is this exact error, and give the steps to free a slot or upgrade.

steps.text: Reconnecting an existing account counts against the connected-account limit, so Reconnect fails until you free a slot.
Go to Accounts and disconnect an account you no longer use, then reconnect.
To increase your limit instead, go to Settings > Billing, click View Billing Portal, and click the purple Update subscription button.
Select Creator for up to 40 accounts or Agency for up to 100 accounts, then confirm the change.
Reconnecting a removed account does not restore archived automations.
